messages:
matt_sales: Quick heads-up — FinCap (POC) needs consolidated privacy + security answers by EOW. They sent a SIG/CAIQ export and a redlined DPA. Main asks: which SCCs template we rely on, proposed DPA language for subprocessors & deletion, SIG->product mapping, and DSAR/deletion workflow. Can we triage?

ella_privacy: Are they storing raw prompts or structured transaction text? They said 'transaction descriptions' may include names/IDs. Need to know whether we treat that as personal data for DSARs.

sanjay_sec: We can map CAIQ controls to our controls. I'll pull the CAIQ->control sheet and flag any 'partial' items (e.g., customer-side logging). For SCCs, we reference the EU Commission 2021 SCCs. On deletion: hosted customers get account-level deletion + per-record API; backups follow retention window (default 30d). If they need shorter retention we should confirm contractually.

matt_sales: They specifically asked for "certified deletion" evidence and a short paragraph for their vendor risk team. Can legal + eng propose language? Also pricing question: would a Dedicated instance (separate tenancy) change deletion guarantees?

roman_eng: For Dedicated/Private we can provide per-tenant key separation (customer-managed KMS) and wipe keys for crypto-delete. For hosted we offer KMS key rotation and KV cache purge. For 'certified deletion' we can produce purge logs + job run timestamps and key-rotation proof, but true crypto-erase depends on their key model.

sasha_legal: Draft DPA language they can copy into their checklist: 

```
Redwood Inference will, upon Customer's verifiable deletion request, delete Customer Data from active production systems within thirty (30) days and provide written confirmation. Backups will be overwritten or destroyed in accordance with Redwood's backup retention and restoration policies; Redwood will provide evidence of deletion actions (timestamped job logs and, where applicable, key-rotation records) upon request.
```

sasha_legal: Also recommend adding this SCC note: "Redwood relies on the EU Commission Standard Contractual Clauses (2021) for transfers and maintains an up-to-date subprocessors list available on request."

security-bot: CAIQ mapping uploaded: https://files.redwood/caqi/fin-cap/1755001234-ca iq-mapping.xlsx :point_up: (doc includes control status and remediation notes).

ella_privacy: Two follow-ups: 1) DSAR flow: who on our side runs the deletion confirmation? 2) Do we preserve redaction logs for auditors? We don't want to expose other customers.

sanjay_sec: DSAR flow suggestion: sales creates request ticket -> privacy triage (ella) -> eng runs deletion job + provides purge-run logs -> legal issues confirmation to customer. We keep audit logs but redact tenant identifiers; retention of audit metadata is default for 90 days unless contract says otherwise.

roman_eng: Implementation note: deletion job writes to an immutable audit table with limited access, and we can export a timestamped CSV for customer-facing confirmation. That CSV contains request id, deletion job id, scope, completion timestamp. No other customer data included.

matt_sales: Perfect. Next steps: Sasha will finalize the short DPA snippet today; Sanjay will attach CAIQ mapping and highlight partial controls; Roman will confirm the path to purge logs and sample CSV. I'll consolidate and send to FinCap tomorrow AM. Thanks all. :pray:

sasha_legal: Uploaded final DPA snippet to the drive and left a one-paragraph summary for Risk.

security-bot: Reminder: remember to update the subprocessors list in the vendor portal after sign-off.
